profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Experienced software developer with a demonstrated history of working in industry. SOLID in object oriented programming, strong background in mathematics, design patterns, test driven development, algorithms, and data structures. Obtained a BS focused in Computer Science from the University of Texas at El Paso in 2017.

I truly enjoy software development, so if you write or encounter any good software related article or video please share with me!

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Responsible for the gathering and analyzing of client requirements, the creation of relevant software and database documentation, and the development, deployment, and maintenance of client software within an Agile environment.

company.name: The University of Texas at El Paso

positions.title: Student Co op Technical
positions.description: Development program where I worked in multiple projects including web development using PHP and JS, automation projects using python and SQL, and  participated in multiple development activities such as toast masters.
